title: pi guard configuration
description: Configuration for the pi guard extension (CARE pre-execution verification + safety tiers + bwrap sandbox + permission prompts). Lives at ~/.pi/agent/guard.jsonc — a JSONC file, so comments and trailing commas are allowed.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file (editor hint).

defaultTier.description: Safety tier at startup. off = no sandbox, everything prompts (CARE still blocks DENY); on = sandbox, whitelisted network via proxy-only egress, new hosts prompt; net = sandbox with full host network (whitelist ignored); isolated = sandbox, no network; readonly = everything read-only, writes and network blocked.

mode.description: CARE decision thresholds. strict = tighter (more commands land in WARN/DENY), auto = wider WARN band.

warnPolicy.description: How the WARN band is handled. prompt = ask the human judge (default); deny = treat WARN like DENY (hard block).

allowedReadDirs.description: Directories (supports a leading ~) whose files are auto-allowed for the read tool, in addition to the project directory.

writableDirs.description: Directories (supports a leading ~) bound writable inside the bwrap sandbox. Everything else stays read-only; the project directory is always writable in the on/net tiers. Ignored in the readonly tier.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts the `on` tier may reach (pre-approved; everything else prompts the human, denied by default with no UI). Patterns: exact hostnames, `*.domain` wildcards, optional `:port` suffix (e.g. `github.com`, `*.github.com`, `github.com:443`). The `on` tier is always proxy-only egress — with an empty list, every host prompts. Ignored in `net` (unrestricted) and in the no-network tiers.

deniedHosts.description: Hosts always denied, checked before allowedHosts (no prompt). Same pattern syntax. A bare `*` here denies everything.

allowedEnv.description: Environment variables passed through to sandboxed commands, in addition to the fixed base (HOME, PATH, TERM, LANG, LC_ALL, TZ, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, PWD, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR). Everything else is stripped from the sandbox env — secrets are opt-in, e.g. CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN.

commandClasses.description: Per-class command overrides: { "WRITE_LOCAL": ["nix"] } reclassifies the listed command heads — config wins over the built-in lexicon (the class's base score and path boosts still apply). Subcommand-aware heads (git, rm, chmod, dd, docker/podman, kill, sed -i) keep their subcommand logic.

overrides.description: Per-head / per-path escape hatches. allow* entries are the only way to override a DENY.

allowHeads.description: Command heads to force-allow (lifts WARN/DENY). Prefer head+subcommand specificity.

denyHeads.description: Command heads to force-deny regardless of CARE's verdict.

allowPaths.description: Substrings that, when present in the command, force-allow it.

denyPaths.description: Substrings that, when present in the command, force-deny it.
